SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS m, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
 sum(gross_amount) AS gross, sum(net_amount) AS net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_lines,
 min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-30' AND DATE '2024-10-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id, s.region, (f.channel_code) ch, w.status,
  strftime(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE),'%Y-%m') AS disp_m,
  strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS sale_m,
  count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-20'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,4,5,6

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_2024,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date IS NULL) AS null_dates
FROM lines
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS d, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
mine_m AS (
    SELECT store_id, strftime(d,'%Y-%m') AS m, sum(net) AS net FROM mine WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, strftime(business_date,'%Y-%m') AS m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) AS store_id, coalesce(a.m,b.m) AS m, a.net AS mine, b.net AS ctl, round(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(b.net,0),2) AS diff
FROM mine_m a FULL JOIN ctl b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND a.m=b.m
WHERE abs(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(b.net,0))>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, count(*) AS lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS outside_validity,
  min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id IN (101,102,103,104,105,114,900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(SUM(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31'), 2) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat,
       ROUND(SUM(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'), 2) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
